content: Iwa ojinọng wani kw'ofon k'okhubha kwa mgbegbeho s'Ephraim, kw'okpen Mika,

obeni ọkka bi, “Ashekẹl pa silva nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh chi pa bẹ atzọk ka mbọhk sọ, pa areng abẹ anang ọnọng kw'ọtzọk ẹmma, pa mbiri mmaanga da agbaakhi okhuri, kkeri bẹ ma e, kaam wọ ndọk bẹ e.” Ọkka on-oben bi, “Nnwa kwaam, tte Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọdọ-ọ!”

Mada orikhi ashekẹl mba pa silva nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh chi ọnang ọkka, ọkka on-oben bi, “K'odik-ọkka, kaam ntte asilva mba paam ọbọhk nnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, ifha nnwa kwaam osi ọgbatza kwa bẹ atzima silva abhọri. Kaam ńdọkha ọgbatza nwa mkpa nnam nnang-ọ.”
Mada orikhi asilva mba ọnang ọkka, ọkka ọn-ọtzọkha ashẹkẹl arọbh jobh pa silva ọnang otzetzekha kwa silva, kw'otzim bẹ oduk ọgbatza nwa. Wa bẹ atzọkh-ẹ atza ahok k'ọhọhm kwa Mika.
Iwa ojinọng nwa kw'okpen Mika okkekkeni ọkhaama ọkhapa, wa osi ẹphọd ọmaana ikha sa ẹhọhmmọr, okwu ọtzọkha nnwa wani kwẹ kw'ijinọng, otzima osi ọfọhnẹja kwẹ.
K'ogbe nwa, wa anọng p'Israẹl ọvaarnọng kakhaam, wa ọnọng kpenamkpen orukhi akpen p'adaakh-ẹ.
Iwa odikkobh kw'efonamma cha Lẹvi, ka Bẹtẹlẹhẹm k'ẹkhọma cha Juda,
obina oji Bẹtẹlẹhẹm ka Juda oror ibe idọdọk s'owobha. Mada oreng k'eden, ọtza ọyaakha k'ọhọhm kwa Mika, k'okhubha kwa mgbegbeho s'Ephraim.
Mika ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Kọ afon man o?” Oben bi, “Kaam mfon k'efonamma cha Lẹvi, ka Bẹtẹlẹhẹm k'ẹkhọma cha Juda e. Kaam nnori ibe sa nwobha.”

Mẹ wọ ofon, Mika oben-ẹ bi, “Kọ ruk ma ttar-m, ifha ade otte ọmaana ọfọhnẹja kwaam. Kaam ńnang-ọ ashẹkẹl jobh pa silva ka cho, mbiri nnang-ọ ọbara ttara ọchattọhk.” Ojinọng nwa kw'efonamma cha Lẹvi odim k'ẹtzaanga.
Wa odikkobh nwa kwa Lẹvi okhera bi, oruk ttar-ẹ. Odikkobh nwa on-ode macha nnwa wani kwẹ kw'ijinọng.
Mando kwa Mika osi odikkobh nwa kwa Lẹvi ọfọhnẹja kwẹ, obiro oruk k'ọhọhm kwẹ.
Mika e, oben bi, “Kaam nkk'nna nnonga bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ósi ejibha osi ọnang-m, da odikkobh nwa kwa Lẹvi ọkk'ọfọhnẹja kwaam ọn-ọda.”
